name: Caroline Ellison

summary.text: Caroline Ellison was chief executive of Alameda Research, the trading firm affiliated with the FTX cryptocurrency exchange founded by Sam Bankman-Fried. She pleaded guilty to fraud charges, cooperated with prosecutors and testified against Bankman-Fried. On September 24, 2024 U.S. District Judge Lewis Kaplan in Manhattan sentenced her to two years in prison and three years of supervised release and ordered forfeiture of about $11 billion; her offences carried a statutory maximum of 110 years.
